newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Brasilprev may take on new partners - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Brasilprev may take on new partners - paper.

text.p: The Second-largest Brazilian pension manager Brasilprev, whose products are distributed exclusively by Banco do Brasil, may forge new partnerships with other retail banks, a local newspaper said.
Gazeta Mercantil quoted Fuad Noman, president of the private firm, as saying Brasilprev is studying taking on new partners among banks which do not have pension products of their own.
He did not name any potential new associates, it said.
"Banco do Brasil is certainly a very strong sales channel and will continue to be our main channel, but we are looking at alternatives," Noman said.
The paper quoted Banco do Brasil's executive superintendent for security, Ismar Torres, said the move would be welcomed by the state-run bank, which owns a 40-percent stake in Brasilprev.
